name: META-AIML Lite
author: META-AIML

sections.description:
META-AIML Lite – AI-Compatible Website Metadata

META-AIML Lite is a simplified version of the META-AIML plugin that allows you to manually add META-AIML schemas to your website. This lightweight plugin provides essential functionality for integrating AI-compatible metadata without complex features.

What is META-AIML?
META-AIML is an independent metadata framework designed to help AI systems understand websites better and faster through structured data markup.

Key Features:
* 🎯 Simple JSON schema editor with syntax highlighting
* 🚀 Manual schema integration into website header
* ✅ Basic formatting and validation tools
* 📱 Clean, lightweight admin interface
* 🔧 No external dependencies required
* 🌐 Compatible with existing Schema.org markup
* 📊 Improves AI understanding of your content
* 🔍 SEO benefits through structured data

Perfect for:
* Users who want basic META-AIML integration
* Developers who prefer manual schema control
* Small to medium websites needing structured data
* Testing and learning META-AIML concepts
* Sites requiring lightweight schema solutions

Why Use META-AIML?
* AI Compatibility: Makes your website more understandable to AI systems
* SEO Benefits: Structured data can improve search engine understanding
* Future-Proof: Prepare your site for AI-driven web interactions
* Easy Implementation: No coding required, simple interface
* Flexible: Works with any WordPress theme

For Advanced Features:
The full version includes real-time validation, template library, quality analytics, automated schema generation, and more advanced features. Learn more at: meta-aiml.org/integrations

Resources:
* Official Website
* Documentation
* Schema Playground
* Schema Examples
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:
1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
3. Search for “META-AIML Lite”
4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/meta-aiml-lite/
3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
4. Go to META-AIML Lite in your admin menu
5. Use the editor to create your schema
6. Save to integrate the schema into your website

After Installation:
1. Navigate to META-AIML Lite in your WordPress admin menu
2. Create your first schema using the JSON editor
3. Use the formatting tools to ensure proper syntax
4. Save your schema to add it to your website’s header
5. Visit your website to see the structured data in action
sections.faq:
What is META-AIML and how is it different from Schema.org?

META-AIML is an independent metadata framework specifically designed for AI compatibility. While Schema.org focuses on search engines, META-AIML is optimized for AI systems understanding. They work together – you can use both on the same website.

Do I need the full version or is the Lite version enough?

The Lite version is perfect for basic schema integration and manual control. Choose the full version if you need automated schema generation, real-time validation, template libraries, or advanced analytics features.

Do I need technical knowledge to use this plugin?

Basic knowledge of JSON is helpful but not required. The plugin includes syntax highlighting and formatting tools. You can also use our Enhanced Schema Playground and documentation with examples for different business types.

Will this conflict with my existing structured data?

No, META-AIML works alongside other structured data like Schema.org, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards without conflicts. It adds additional AI-compatible metadata to your website.

How do I know if my schema is working?

After saving your schema, you can view your website’s source code to see the META-AIML structured data in the <head> section. You can also use our validation tools.

Does this plugin affect my website’s performance?

META-AIML Lite is designed to be lightweight with minimal impact on your website’s performance. The structured data is added to the header without additional HTTP requests or external dependencies.

Can I use this with any WordPress theme?

Yes, META-AIML Lite works with any properly coded WordPress theme. The structured data is added to the website header regardless of your theme choice.

Is there support available?

For the Lite version, you can find documentation and examples. The full version includes priority support and additional resources.
